note: Pair clear % on L7-L10 with the run's signature pair in hand. The gate rule was 'pair >= 60%', a floor with no ceiling — a run at 100% solves itself the moment you hold both cards. Tyler's band is 60-80%.

coverage.note: Tyler 2026-09-07: the ladder should encompass every ability. Six player-facing cards never appear in any rung's kit, so a ladder-only player can never hold them. Four existing runs looked like they closed the gap. Measuring all four killed three of them.

candidates.name: The Turnstile
candidates.band: ELIGIBLE — signature 72/63/72/72, worst 63, inside the band; every single card 0%.

candidates.name: The Picket
candidates.band: FAILS — its signature worst is 50% (below the 60 floor), and its own kit contains aegis+rewind at 97%, a free route. Needs rework before it can carry a rung.

candidates.name: The Switchback
candidates.band: DEAD — nothing clears it. Signature worst 53%.

coverage.result: Only The Turnstile is ready. Approving it takes the ladder to 19 of 23 (11 rungs). bishop-step, rabies-dart, page and rewind still have no working run — closing those means BUILDING runs, not approving them. The alternative is to accept 19 of 23 on the ladder and let trophies carry the rest.

endless.how: Roll 5 random abilities from all live cards, then play levels that never stop getting harder. No win state, no retries: it ends when you die, and your score is how deep you got.
endless.ramp: Rookie 1-3, Normal 4-6, Hard 7-9, then Nightmare from 10 with +1 enemy per turn and -1 move every 4 levels, forever.
endless.pool: 120 levels from the 12 broad-kit runs. Combo runs are excluded entirely — a random kit cannot beat a level only one specific pair opens.
endless.where: Gold ENDLESS strip under DAILY REVENGE on the Revenge tab.

difficulty.headline: The four difficulty modes are decorative on every run you can currently play.
difficulty.detail: First all-difficulty measurement ever taken: 60 full runs per run per mode. Eleven of the twelve live broad-kit runs clear 100% on every level at every difficulty INCLUDING Nightmare, with zero deaths. All 13 measured runs have at least one pair of adjacent modes within 8pp. No inversions — a harder mode is never easier, it just isn't harder.
difficulty.worst: revenge-13 is the opposite failure: Hard 7%, Nightmare 5%, effectively unwinnable, and the wall is L2 rather than the finale.

routes.headline: Six of 22 combo runs have more than one real answer. The rest are not locked so much as leaky.
routes.template: The Slash: fifteen pairs clear it, seven inside the band — by far the most of any run, and proof a level can be hard and still have many answers.
routes.leak: The runs marked one-answer usually have ONE road in band and several FREE ones above 80% — revenge-26 has 17 such pairs, revenge-33 has 15, The Alcove 12. The problem is not that there is a single road, it is that the other roads are free.
routes.broken: revenge-13's gate is beaten by a single card. revenge-16 and revenge-27 have no answer at all — not even their own signature pair clears.
routes.generalists: knight-hop, become-king, summon-knight, twin, swap and freeze-ray keep clearing finales they were never designed for. decoy, duchess, sacrifice, aegis and convert never once do.
